findings.summary: Resume publication can reach release creation without rechecking the target version surface, so the helper does not fail closed on skew across the full publication lifecycle.
evidence: skills/public/release/scripts/publish_release_execute.py:106-109 runs the bump and then stores ensure_release_surface(..., next_version) at the normal post-bump/pre-commit boundary.
skills/public/release/scripts/publish_release_cli.py:193-216 and skills/public/release/scripts/publish_release_preflight.py:339-365 define and enforce the fail-closed release-surface predicate.

skills/public/release/scripts/publish_release_resume.py:235-240 explicitly records that resume is not gated and that a deleted or corrupted surface reaches publish unchecked; publish_release_resume_publish.py:139-158 omits the gate while :203-220 can push/create/verify.

docs/deferred-decisions.md:740-745 confirms this is a known unresolved gap. The recorded instance is .agents/release-adapter.yaml:16-20 plus the resume lane's unset version_drift_check at publish_release_resume_publish.py:155-157.

Semantic reviewer question: invariant — every publication leg must bind one target version to every required generated surface and refuse drift; owning boundary — bump_version.py/current_release.py/ensure_release_surface, consumed by prepare and resume before create_release; axis-varying counterexample — keep the prepared record and target unchanged but delete or corrupt one required plugin or marketplace surface between prepare and resume. The observed release shape stays similar while the semantic surface state changes, and resume cannot distinguish it.
findings.action: Before any resume path can call create_release, invoke ensure_release_surface(repo_root, target_version, stage='post-claims-review, pre-push') or an equivalent gate and bind its result into the final release artifact; add a resumable negative fixture for required-surface deletion/corruption, mirror the repair, rerun changed-line proof, and obtain the required second bounded review of the repaired verdict surface.

findings.summary: The normal prepare and closeout machinery has the required version, rationale, sync, rollback, and ordering controls, but no v6.5.0 release execution or post-publication evidence exists yet.
evidence: The canonical packet verifier accepted the exact packet and reviewed-input identities; charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-25-release-6-5-0-packet.md:5-31 lists the release surfaces under review.

publish_release_plan.py:41-61 and publish_release_args.py:61-65 derive one semver target and require the rationale to be repeated on resume; bump_version.py:104-128 checks the sync target before writing, writes one packaging target, then runs the adapter sync.

scripts/sync_root_plugin_manifests.py:63-95 regenerates plugins/charness and both root marketplace artifacts from packaging/charness.json. Current checked-in surfaces are consistently 6.4.1 at packaging/charness.json:5, plugins/charness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:3, plugins/charness/.codex-plugin/plugin.json:3, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json:8,14.

publish_release_execute.py:218-229 rolls back pre-commit failures; publish_release_common.py:299-313 orders distinct-channel proof, baton observation, install refresh/version-doctor readback, issue closeout, and final artifact commit after publication.

No v6.5.0 tag exists. charness-artifacts/release/latest.md:6,26-27 and docs/handoff.md:28-41 still record only v6.4.1. .agents/release-adapter.yaml:79-80 has no configured requested-review command, while publish_release_common.py:61-75 records that gate and skills/public/release/references/critique-boundary.md:8-16 requires a standalone critique before execution.
findings.action: After the blocker is repaired, run the planner dry-run, execute the helper with --part minor and an explicit rationale to the prepared claims boundary, complete the bound claims review/resume, and only then record distinct public readback, install refresh, version/doctor readbacks, and handoff reconciliation.

findings.summary: The existing first-reader upgrade path is discoverable and compatible, but target-version behavior remains unproven until the post-publish commands run.
evidence: README.md:42-57 directs the first operator to charness --help, charness doctor, and charness update and distinguishes nonzero update failures; docs/cli-reference.md:89-175 documents update, doctor, and version.

.agents/release-adapter.yaml:12-14,41-43 binds charness update/version/doctor and evergreen release-note/rollback guidance; docs/host-packaging.md:187-211 names the managed checkout and says update keeps the installed plugin equal to the repo while public GitHub install remains unproven until an experiment.

charness:4893-5088 validates refresh/readback and emits next action; :5091-5119 exposes typed doctor state; :5122-5140 emits version/readback. No v6.5.0 invocation has run these paths; prior v6.4.1 readbacks are in charness-artifacts/release/latest.md:136-221.

Reader-facing dispositions: charness update — updated contract, insufficient target evidence because v6.5.0 refresh was not run; charness version — updated contract, insufficient target evidence because no v6.5.0 installed comparison was run; charness doctor — updated contract, insufficient target evidence for the target install, with real-host proof not applicable because the trigger evaluation was a no-match; check_provenance_contract.py and the 156-test/checker commands — not applicable as end-user commands; README/CLI reference — not applicable to the current diff because git diff 7f482ded7cfc3cfde70281832bd52f2878e94360..HEAD changes no CLI/docs command surface.
findings.action: Keep these dispositions in the release record; after publication execute charness update, charness version, and charness doctor and record return codes and next actions. Do not substitute python3 scripts/doctor.py for the managed-install doctor.

findings.summary: The local provenance slice has useful bounded evidence, but it does not establish packaged-final-consumer, live-host, public, or installed adoption.
evidence: charness-artifacts/spec/2026-08-25-consumer-boundary-invariants.md:111-125 records 156 focused tests, source executable-fixture proof, and plugin shape+consumer-anchors proof while explicitly leaving packaged final-consumer fixtures unclaimed.
charness-artifacts/debug/2026-08-25-debug-review-followup.md:26-28,61-62,101-114,147-148 separates focused/local evidence from broad changed-line, release, live-host, and provider proof.

The read-only real-host trigger evaluation for 7f482ded7cfc3cfde70281832bd52f2878e94360..524dc6e8db690a4b91b8dc6f973c453c60f5ea53 returned required:false, evaluation_scope:evaluated, 31 changed paths, and no surface/path hits.

.charness/quality-failure-logs/check-changed-line-mutation-coverage.log reports a historical cumulative origin/main range with uncovered lines and four unmapped mutation-pool files; that is not a clean v6.5.0 release claim. The narrow current-slice proof is retained only as local range-scoped evidence.
findings.action: Carry the 156-test/checker results, fresh-checkout result, narrow current-slice proof, no-trigger evaluation, and explicit non-claims into the claims review and release artifact without promoting them to public/live/install proof.

counterweight_triage.concern: Resume can publish after a required generated surface is deleted or corrupted.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Real publication blocker: it violates the helper's fail-closed version-surface contract; repair and re-review the resume verdict surface.

counterweight_triage.concern: The v6.5.0 helper, public readback, and install refresh have not yet run.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Expected before publication and not a pre-publication design blocker, but the release must not be closed or described as public until those steps produce bound evidence.

counterweight_triage.concern: The broad origin/main changed-line run carries historical cumulative debt and unmapped mutation-pool files.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Real evidence-quality debt outside this two-commit current slice; use the narrow proof and state the broad non-claim.

counterweight_triage.concern: The real-host trigger was evaluated and did not match this slice.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The configured trigger evaluation returned evaluated/no-match over 31 paths; no live-host proof is required for this slice, and the no-proof disposition should remain explicit.

counterweight_triage.concern: Packaged final-consumer fixtures are not claimed by the plugin checker.
counterweight_triage.disposition: A real future packaging/adoption proof gap, but the current release contract records shape+consumer-anchors as the plugin proof level and does not require packaged pytest fixtures.

counterweight_triage.concern: Existing operators might need a new migration or command.
counterweight_triage.disposition: No CLI/docs command surface changed in the current slice and the existing update/version/doctor path is understandable; let the generated v6.5.0 record carry rationale and any release-specific migration or rollback note.

next_move: Block publication on the resume release-surface skew bypass. After repair, run plan_release_run.py --repo-root . --detail, then prepare v6.5.0 with --part minor and --bump-rationale "minor: typed producer-to-final-consumer provenance contract and executable checks across reviewer, lesson, manifest, and duplicate-lineage boundaries; existing callers remain compatible", stop for the bound claims review, resume with exact original arguments, and only then perform and record distinct public readback, charness update, charness version, charness doctor, and docs/handoff reconciliation.
non_claims: The v6.5.0 release helper has not been executed; no target release artifact, tag, or publication exists.
No v6.5.0 hosted/public readback or distinct-channel verification was performed; current public evidence is only v6.4.1 in charness-artifacts/release/latest.md.
No v6.5.0 install refresh or installed charness version/doctor readback was performed; prior v6.4.1 readbacks do not transfer.
No real-host proof was performed for this slice; the trigger evaluator ran over 31 paths and returned evaluated/no-match, so this is a non-applicable proof, not a pass about live hosts.
The plugin provenance checker proves shape+consumer-anchors only; packaged final-consumer pytest fixtures are explicitly unclaimed.
No live Ceal/Claude/provider roundtrip, Windows race, online link, installed-session, GitHub, push/release, or Cautilus proof is claimed for the provenance slice.

The broad origin/main changed-line run is not a clean release claim: its historical cumulative range reports uncovered pre-existing local lines and unmapped mutation-pool files; only the narrow 7f482ded7cfc3cfde70281832bd52f2878e94360..current-HEAD proof is scoped as passed.
The 156 focused tests and source/plugin checker results are local slice evidence, not evidence that every public, packaged, or installed consumer adopted the release.
